# Purest Electrolyte

> Purest makes real fruit electrolyte powder packaged in clear glass jars.

Last updated: 2026-09-06

## Core facts

- Brand: Purest Electrolyte
- Category: Real fruit electrolyte in a glass jar
- Ingredients approach: Real freeze-dried fruit and French gray sea salt
- Packaging: Clear glass jars that make the product visible
- Product media: Current product images are maintained in the official Purest catalog
- Excludes: Natural flavors, artificial dyes, maltodextrin, preservatives, and anti-caking agents
- Flavors: Ginger Lime, Hibiscus Lime, Passion Cherry, Cranberry, and Chocolate Cordyceps
- Official website: https://www.purestelectrolyte.com/
